sophie: Heads-up — onboarding health playbook flagged ~200 accounts as 'stalled' but a quick check shows a lot are false positives. Seems correlated with the new consent opt-out flow. Logs: `playbook-run id=pt-4892 error=no_telemetry`

raj: I dug in — event `onboard-event` is being suppressed for users who opt out of analytics. Playbook assumes missing telemetry == stalled. We should add a consent check and skip accounts with `consent=false`.

cs-ops-bot: playbook-run pt-4892 completed 11:37:42, flagged=198, marked_no_contact=74 (reaction :warning:)

elena: Can we also add a dedupe/fallback rule? If last_touch_ts > 90d then skip, or check `onboard_status != "started"` before flagging. That would cut legit false positives.

tam: I pushed a small patch to staging: branch `cs/playbook/consent-skip`. It's a quick guard in the runner. PR: https://git.redwood/s/cs/playbook/+/2345 — needs a smoke dry-run.

raj: Also proposing a telemetry enrichment fallback: when `onboard-event` is missing, query `enrichment.device_pings` for recent pings (ttl 7d). If found, treat as active. Low lift and will reduce FP.

sophie: :thumbsup: OK. Plan: add consent-skip + device ping fallback, then run a dry-run sample and compute false positive rate. If FP < 10% we can canary to 5% prod.

dave (devex): I can run the sampling job. Command I'll use:

```
python cs_playbook/run.py --playbook stalled_onboard --dry-run --sample 500 --out s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/1748067890.json
```

Will post results to this thread + short CSV of flagged ids.

elena: Note: the healthscore-delta alerts started firing this morning for AMs; we should silence those while we run dry-runs, otherwise they'll get noisy. @mike can you pause alerts with tag=playbook-dryrun?

mike: mike: pausing healthscore alerts for tag=playbook-dryrun until 1748068500. Done.

sophie: Great. Timeline proposal: staging patch + dry-run in ~2h, analysis 1h after job completes, then merge and 5% canary rollout the following day. Any objections?

raj: No objections. If staging reveals any edgecases we'll add additional filters.

tam: I can run the staging dry-run in ~2 hours and monitor logs. I expect the job will take ~30-45m with the enrichment lookup.

dave (devex): I'll set up the S3 path and a quick Looker dashboard to inspect FP by cohort. Path: s3://redwood-cs/dryruns/1748067890.json and derived table cs_dryrun.stalled_1748067890

sophie: Thanks everyone. I'll create a follow-up doc with rollout steps and AM communications after we have results. Appreciated :heart:
